name: Tona TTS Reader
author: tonadesigns

sections.description:
Tona TTS Reader allows users to listen to your website content using built-in browser speech synthesis.

Features include:
– Play, pause, resume, and stop controls
– Adjustable reading speed
– Voice selection
– Highlighting of currently spoken text
– Smart content detection
– Floating UI for easy access

No external APIs required — uses the browser’s native speech engine.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Configure settings if needed
sections.faq:
Does this use external APIs?

No. This plugin uses the browser’s built-in speech synthesis engine.

Does it work on mobile?

Yes, but voice availability depends on the device/browser.
